# Carlos Alberto Haro (h1sort.com)

> Personal website of Carlos Alberto Haro López, AI Engineer & Technical Product Manager at Santander AI in Mexico City. 8+ years designing and shipping end-to-end data & AI solutions across AWS, Azure, and GCP: production AI agents, RAG systems, MLOps, and data platforms.

Highlights: FRED, a structured fraud-analysis agent in production at Santander Mexico (10k credit petitions analyzed in 1 hour, replacing a ~1k-per-week manual bottleneck); a cloud RAG chatbot for the branch network and contact center; ProntoGPT, an internal agent harness that influenced org-wide AI access; AI teaching for 300+ employees across 6 bank areas. Previously Manager at Accenture Data & AI (cloud MLOps frameworks, analytics platform assessments, omnichannel data models).

## Pages

- [CV](https://h1sort.com/cv/): animated walk through 8+ years across the full data lifecycle
- [CV as PDF](https://h1sort.com/cv.pdf): downloadable one-pager
- [Talking](https://h1sort.com/talking/): public talks, live sessions, and threads on databases, OLAP vs OLTP, DuckDB, data science, and the modern data stack
- [Teaching](https://h1sort.com/teaching/): Real-Time Data Processing, a 12-lesson hands-on course (OLTP, CDC, Kafka, stream processing, real-time OLAP, API)
- [Writing](https://h1sort.com/writing/): blog and research write-ups (in progress)
- [Devin Model Guide](https://h1sort.com/devin-model-guide/): an unlinked public field note on role-based model allowlists, escalation workflows, benchmark evidence, and dynamic ACU budgeting for Devin Desktop
- [Live Polls](https://h1sort.com/polls/): create grouped multiple-choice polls and participate through short links or QR codes
- [Fantastic Agents](https://h1sort.com/slides/fantastic-agents/): a 23-slide illustrated field guide to production agents, their authority, and the controls around them
- [AI en la banca](https://h1sort.com/gbm-ai/): an 18-slide Spanish talk for the GBM AI Experience on how banking analytics evolved from cheap analysis to judgment built into infrastructure, with live demos and a QR survey
- [El futuro de los servicios financieros](https://h1sort.com/snowflake/): a 15-minute Spanish talk for Snowflake World Tour Mexico City 2026 on when to trust an agent: Confianza = Contexto × Evidencia × Control (if one factor is zero, trust is zero), with slides as PDF and an interactive isometric machine
- [Tool use sin abstracciones](https://h1sort.com/claude4aieng/): a 40-minute hands-on Spanish workshop for the Claude Community CDMX (19 Oct 2026) on tool use at the wire level: chat templates, the tool_use and tool_result loop, constrained decoding, three deliberate breakages and how to fix them, and measuring tool-call error rates; code at github.com/h1sort/claude4aieng
- [Contact](https://h1sort.com/contact/): email and socials
